decision_basis: Two independent Docker canonical-build cycles produced the same zte_tpd.ko SHA-256.
Candidate and stock AArch64 assembly have identical 136 instructions, 544-byte symbol size and resolved relocations.
Candidate and stock KCFI type IDs are identical: 0xe5c47d60.
Strict Joern gate passed with zero parse problems and one-to-one source/Ghidra identity coverage.
The dedicated ASAN/UBSAN harness passed 3/3 tests in both cycles, directly covering the null guard and complete ordered proc-entry teardown.
